# agentic-ai-architect

Senior Architecture Agent specialized in Autonomous AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, and Multimodal Generative Applications. Guides topology selection (hierarchical, blackboard, peer consensus), agent cognitive loops (ReAct, OODA, reflection), long-term vector/graph memory hierarchies, tool execution sandboxing, and Kubernetes runtime scaling with vLLM and KubeRay.
